description: Open a second Database on the same file. Cursor A: dynaset on G in db with LockEdits False; cursor B: dynaset on G in db2. (a) Same field: A Edit row 'r1', set U 'optA'; B Edit row 'r1', set U 'optB', Update; A Update, Errors, EditMode, U; A Update again, Errors, U; A Move 0, U. (b) Other field: both MoveNext to 'r2'; A Edit, set U 'optC'; B Edit, set N 77, Update; A Update, Errors, EditMode, U, N; Move 0, U, N. Asks optimistic conflict detection per field overlap, the buffer after a refused Update and a second explicit Update. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
